mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows patients without assigned records and non-patients with assigned records, violating FR-002's single-role and patient-record-pairing invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BadUserRole { some u: User | u.role = Patient and no u.assigned_record }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows non-clinicians or inactive memberships to exist in CareTeamMembership, violating FR-004's requirement that only active clinician-record pairs grant access.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidCareTeam { some ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.clinician.role != Clinician or ctm.is_active != 1 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows clinical notes to exist without corresponding audit entries, violating FR-013's audit completeness requirement.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAuditForNote { some cn: ClinicalNote | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.note_id = cn and ae.operation = Append and ae.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows malformed audit entries (e.g., note_id present on read operations, record absent for non-system-wide operations), violating FR-014's structural requirements.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MalformedAudit { some ae: AuditEntry | (ae.operation = Read and one ae.note_id) or (ae.operation = Append and ae.outcome = Permitted and no ae.note_id) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows duplicate audit entries (same accessor, operation, record), violating FR-015's immutability and the audit log's append-only semantics.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAudit { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.accessor = ae2.accessor and ae1.operation = ae2.operation and ae1.record = ae2.record }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows non-clinicians to author notes, violating FR-010's validation requirement that only clinicians author clinical notes.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientAuthoredNote { some cn: ClinicalNote | cn.author.role != Clinician }
